request.style: English, warm female solo voice, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, soft percussion, hopeful and tender, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Praise the LORD with a joyful song
It is good to sing to our God
How pleasant it is
How fitting to praise him
The LORD rebuilds Jerusalem
He gathers the outcasts of Israel

[Chorus]
He heals the brokenhearted
And binds up their wounds
He heals the brokenhearted
And binds up their wounds

[Verse]
He counts the number of the stars
And calls each one by name
Great is our Lord
Mighty in power
His understanding has no limit

[Chorus]
He heals the brokenhearted
And binds up their wounds
He heals the brokenhearted
And binds up their wounds

[Bridge]
The LORD lifts up the humble
He casts the wicked to the ground
His power is endless
His love is deep

[Outro]
He heals the brokenhearted
And binds up their wounds
